images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Breachline high-fantasy painted reference art, landscape PNG 1536 x 1024. Warm ivory EMPTY background. Traditional oil/acrylic painting with measured visible brushwork, matte skin and cloth, diffuse neutral daylight. Coherent large light/shadow shapes and precise focal anatomy; no pore-noise, waxy sheen, photography, CGI, anime, glossy animated-film or cute toy treatment. All figures adults, intelligent and clothed in plain practical neutral garments. No printed text, letters, numbers, labels, frames, border, signatures, logos or watermarks. Keep all anatomy inside the page with breathing room; hands and limb connections physically coherent. No scenery or camera blur.
Create ONE CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of a single consistent design. Left two thirds: three FULL BODY views at the same scale, front three-quarter, side and rear, complete head to feet, standing relaxed. Right third: a large three-quarter head-and-shoulders portrait above a smaller profile head and a close hand/forearm anatomy study. Do not repeat the source's six-cell lineup. Exactly the same anatomy, clothing and individual in every view.
The attached sheet is a design reference. Select TAKE SIX, BOTTOM RIGHT ONLY for the person: very tall extremely narrow adult, long neck, long hands and arms, dark slate-brown skin, large soft ear-fans, small ordinary nonluminous eyes, no hair. Preserve precisely this individual, facial structure, ear shapes, extreme slender body proportions and the simple sleeveless neutral wrap tunic and cropped trousers. Do NOT import the enlarged eyes or human face of take four.
The creator wants denser luminous freckles LIKE TAKE FOUR (BOTTOM LEFT), but keep SIX's BLUE colour and recognizable vertical dotted lines. Add a clearly visible dense constellation/mask of small blue-white light points across cheeks, brow, nose and temples, at a comparable density to take four. Repeat a few groups on the ear bases and shoulders. Preserve the paired vertical dotted light trails down the long neck.
Most important arm pattern: orderly visible dotted LINES continue DOWN the upper arm and elbow. On each lower forearm, the dots gradually BRANCH and SPREAD OUT laterally; toward the wrist and back of the hand they become a broad dense constellation rather than a single line. Maintain a readable linear spine up the arm, with scattered smaller satellite points, and denser spread at the BOTTOM of the arms. The forearm close-up must demonstrate that ordered-line-to-spreading-cluster transition. Keep luminosity unmistakable on the ivory background, each dot distinct with modest luminous edges. Skin itself stays matte and nonluminous; eyes never glow. No neon circuits, solid luminous ribbons, jewelry, tattoos or decorative costume. No stars floating off the skin. Preserve two arms, two legs and existing long fine fingers.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Breachline high-fantasy painted PEOPLE design sheet. Landscape PNG 1536 x 1024, plain warm ivory empty background. SIX invisible cells in two rows of three, each with one complete adult full body plus a larger matching head-and-shoulders portrait beside it. Same scale for full bodies; varied mature personalities, ages and sexes; simple relaxed standing poses. Clear bodily proportions, visible feet and functional hands. No text, numerals, lettering, boxes, frames or signatures.
Traditional oil/acrylic fantasy illustration, measured visible brushwork and nuanced matte colour. Soft neutral daylight. Natural wool, linen and leather clothing with simple medieval-fantasy closures, modest and practical; anatomy rather than equipment carries variation. Quiet character and worldly intelligence.
LATEST CREATOR DIRECTION: keep exaggerated facial structures and unusual bodies, easing exaggeration only A LITTLE to fit grounded painted fantasy. Do NOT normalize everyone into humans. Uniqueness matters, not folding anatomy. Avoid repeated fan-like flesh folds, ridges all over bodies, science-fiction alien archetypes, black featureless oval eyes, slick bald extraterrestrial heads, rubber suits and grotesque overdesign. Features should form a coherent living person. No photorealism, CGI, anime, cute animation, glossy skin, clinical diagrams or camera blur.

The attachment is a source sheet: use ONLY BOTTOM LEFT TAKE FOUR as design continuity. Preserve its organic fur, long limbs, intelligent slightly nonhuman face and simple woven clothes. IGNORE every other cell; this is six variations around ONE people, not six unrelated species. Maintain a restrained recognisably related family of skulls and bodies. Two arms and two legs each, no tails, scales, skin pleats or gliding features. Exaggerated cheekbones, brow, nose and mouth shapes may remain, eased only slightly from the source.
TOP LEFT: closest to source, adult man with long slim legs and arms, thick charcoal-grey shoulder/neck ruff, subtle face fur, long narrow face and long splayed toes; knee-length plain wool tunic.
TOP MIDDLE: adult woman, slightly shorter build, cropped ruff down to upper chest, broad expressive brow and squarish cheekbones, tapered chin, tawny charcoal fur; plain tunic and woven belt.
TOP RIGHT: middle-aged man, compact deep-chested build, long forearms and hands, a broad blunt face with small perceptive eyes, dense short dark neck fur; simple grey sleeveless tunic over naturally furred shoulders.
BOTTOM LEFT: lean adult woman, high cheekbones, long narrow nose and alert mouth, longer legs, tawny-grey cheek fur merging into short ruff; plain fitted but practical wool tunic.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: elderly man, longer neck and pale-tipped grey ruff, slightly bowed upper back, matte exposed facial skin with strong serene planes, lightly furred backs of hands; unadorned woven clothes.
BOTTOM RIGHT: younger adult of mature age with minimal facial fur, short close crown fur, smooth strong expressive face and a smaller continuous shoulder ruff, average build with slightly long hands and shins; practical linen tunic.
Each variation must remain clearly PL5.4-related, with fur treated in broad painted locks, not individual hair detail everywhere. No new giant size, claws or fangs.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Breachline fantasy painted concept/reference sheet, 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG. Warm ivory EMPTY backdrop. Traditional oil and acrylic fantasy painting with measured visible brushwork, matte skin and cloth, coherent diffuse daylight, sharp thoughtful facial detail, simpler secondary marks. Not photography, CGI, animation, cartoon, anime or glossy plastic. Keep exaggerated interesting facial planes and coherent bodies; avoid sci-fi extraterrestrial archetypes and repetitive skin folds. No writing, text, labels, numbers, borders, signatures or watermarks. All people adults, clothed simply and modestly in practical handmade neutral fantasy garments. Complete heads, hands and feet inside the composition.
Exactly SIX invisible cells, TWO ROWS of THREE. Each cell contains one full-body adult standing calmly and one larger matching head-and-shoulders portrait of that individual beside it. All full bodies at common scale. Keep clean breathing room and no drawn grid.
Subject: six design studies for Dominion's MADE PEOPLE, now imagined visually as PEOPLE RAISED FROM THE DEAD AT A COST. The creator specifically asks for a stronger revived-dead appearance. The old constraint that they must merely look pale while wholly alive is superseded for this exploration. They may have little or no soul, but that is uncertain; express diminished presence through embodied detail, never show a soul orb or magical diagram.
They are ordinary adult human scale and mass, 1.55–1.9m, lean or average, five men and one woman, two arms and two legs each. No giants, superhuman bodybuilder bulk, broad hulking shoulders or enormous hands. Keep bodily integrity substantial: upright clothed bodies, recognizable individual faces and purposeful but subdued presence. They should read clearly as returned from death rather than handsome tired people or regular gothic citizens.
VISUAL VOCABULARY: matte cold bloodless skin with subtle dependent blue-grey/violet lividity, dry grey lips, hollow cheeks, faint old CLOSED injuries, diminished warmth in gaze, one or two lightly clouded eyes, hesitant asymmetry or unusual stillness. No fluorescent eyes, no luminous veins, no rot, dripping wounds, exposed organs, skeletons, thread stitches, bolts, necromancer props or lab clichés. These are reserved painted fantasy revenants, with traces of their former personhood; avoid theatrical zombie snarls. Diffuse neutral light and plain dark Dominion clothing.
TOP LEFT: lean adult man, long angular face, distinctly drained grey-olive skin, dark hollow eye sockets and blue-grey dry lips, intact natural eyes staring a little past the viewer, short thin dark hair. Hands hang slightly differently, simple open-neck charcoal tunic.
TOP MIDDLE: compact ordinary-built man with a broad face, a single long CLOSED pale scar across the side of his throat suggesting a past fatal wound, sunken cheeks and muted bruised colour low on neck. Entire throat and skin intact; no wound opening. Plain dark vest; body standing stiffly, calm watchful but diminished.
TOP RIGHT: spare older man with taut ash-brown skin, sparse hair, hollow temples, slightly collapsed chest and long bony ordinary hands; a still gaze and subtly slack lower face suggest a late return. Dark modest sleeveless tunic and trousers, no exposed bones.
BOTTOM LEFT: adult woman, average lean body, matte cold brown-grey skin mottled by subtle violet lividity at temples and forearms, one lightly clouded but nonluminous eye, short uneven dark hair. Faint old closed marks at collarbone. Impassive slightly distant expression, plain dark long-sleeved tunic with sleeves pushed back.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: average-built middle-aged man, entire body intact but patchy muted lividity at jaw and hands, two fine long-healed scars at cheek and chest, dull greyed skin with no healthy blush. Heavy unresponsive shoulders without bulk, slow reserved gaze, simple charcoal clothes.
BOTTOM RIGHT: young-adult man, thin but not emaciated, ash-tan skin, darkened fingertips and lips, very hollow cheeks, old healed mark at brow, mismatched tension between left and right side of face, quiet nearly absent gaze, plain dark belted tunic.
Different faces, ages and histories; shared unmistakable death-and-return appearance. Preserve dignity and unsettling fantasy atmosphere. Ordinary relaxed lineup stance, no combat or graveyard scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Breachline fantasy painted concept/reference sheet, 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG. Warm ivory EMPTY backdrop. Traditional oil and acrylic fantasy painting with measured visible brushwork, matte skin and cloth, coherent diffuse daylight, sharp thoughtful facial detail, simpler secondary marks. Not photography, CGI, animation, cartoon, anime or glossy plastic. Keep exaggerated interesting facial planes and coherent bodies; avoid sci-fi extraterrestrial archetypes and repetitive skin folds. Exactly SIX invisible cells, TWO ROWS of THREE. Each cell contains one full-body adult standing calmly and one larger matching head-and-shoulders portrait of that individual beside it. All full bodies at common scale. Keep clean breathing room and no drawn grid.
Use the attached PL8 sheet. The TOP row is the salt direction; the BOTTOM row is silt. The creator now says they are ONE SPECIES with TWO VARIANTS. Pull them slightly toward each other. Neither keep them as unrelated species nor flatten their distinction into simple recolours.
SHARED ANATOMY in all six: same low swept brow ridge continuing into firm cheekbones, same moderately wide wedge-shaped skull, same low broad nose bridge with a gently projecting blunt tip, similar expressive eyes with visible living irises, strong full mouth and softly angular jaw. Body proportions meet in the middle: moderately deep torso, capable long forearms, medium-length legs and broad three-toed feet. Salt bodies less reed-thin and less long-legged; silt bodies less bulky and less long-armed. Keep ordinary adult size. Shared smooth matte skin and no repetitive trunk folds. Head ridges are a coherent bone silhouette, not fans of folded flesh. The upper row gains a little of the lower row's cheek volume and broad nose; the lower row gains a little of the upper row's swept brow and angular facial length.
VARIANT DIFFERENCES: salt adults warm ochre/tawny with sparse muted cream stripes; silt adults olive-brown with quieter mottling and faint broken lighter bands suggesting the same pigment system. No new gills, hair, crests, ears or tails. Keep personal faces distinct, not clones. Both sexes and ages appear in BOTH variants.
TOP LEFT: mature salt woman, slim-average build, soft pale stripes on shoulders and lower legs, simple grey sleeveless tunic.
TOP MIDDLE: salt man, broader average body, same fundamental head as bottom-middle, sparse broken stripes, plain linen vest and cropped trousers.
TOP RIGHT: older salt woman, warmer weathered tawny skin, muted bands, shared low swept brow, practical wool tunic.
BOTTOM LEFT: silt man, average body closer to top-left proportions, olive-brown skin with a few faint broken pale bands, visibly related swept brow, plain wrap vest.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: silt woman, sturdy but ordinary-size build, the same basic face and foot proportions as salt man above, muted mottled olive skin, short neutral dress.
BOTTOM RIGHT: lean silt man, slightly longer legs, same underlying head as top-right but younger facial character, quiet mottling and simple linen clothes.
The family resemblance should be immediately convincing; these are related variants within one species. Preserve strong fantasy appeal and distinctive faces.

images.source_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: Breachline Crest folk anatomy reference, 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: CR1, the selected Crest folk woman. The creator clarified that "integrate the sweep" meant trying ACTUAL CREST STRUCTURES ON THE ARMS AND BODY, not only changing the head-to-neck attachment.

Preserve this individual's facial identity, original swept fluted head crest, russet cheek marks, chalk-tan skin, slender strong body proportions, ordinary size, hands, feet and simple short grey-brown tunic. Keep the same three full-body front/three-quarter, side and rear views at left, large portrait at upper right, and profile at lower right. Warm ivory empty background, traditional matte oil/acrylic fantasy painting with measured visible brushwork, quiet diffuse light, no printed text.

The NEW ANATOMY must be clearly visible: carry a smaller restrained version of the head crest's material and backward sweep onto BOTH ARMS and the UPPER TORSO. These are shallow organic bony crests growing smoothly out of the body, in the same pale warm-tan material as the head; not clothing, jewelry, tattoos or a suit of armor.
ARMS: two or three low elongated fluted ridges along the outer upper arm, leading into a small swept crest on the outer/back surface of the forearm. Keep the inner elbow, wrist and fingers free, with believable flexible joints. At least one modest crest should visibly change each arm's silhouette in the full-body views. These growths are much smaller than the head crest, elegant and streamlined, never giant spikes, fins or shoulder pauldrons.
TORSO: a pair of modest swept crests rooted in the upper back/shoulder-blade region and small related shallow clavicular ridges at the upper chest. Make the torso growths visible ABOVE the tunic neckline/shoulder openings and in the rear and profile body views, anatomically continuous with the shoulder area. Let the plain existing garment sit naturally around the growths with only small practical neckline/armhole adjustments; retain modest coverage and its existing overall cut. Do not turn the shirt itself into a crest.
Keep the rest of the torso and legs smooth, so the head, shoulder/back and arm crests form one restrained family of shapes. Do not cover her in repeated folds, scales, ribs or jagged plating. Preserve the head crest itself; no need to make it bigger or add a new neck fan. No tail, extra limbs or new species features.
Replace only the existing isolated hand detail at lower right with a clear enlarged shoulder/upper-arm and forearm anatomy detail, showing how these new crests arise from the skin and leave joints functional. Keep enough hand visible to connect the forearm study. All views must agree about the new crest locations.
This is a modest species-design experiment for review, not an armored warrior transformation. Preserve the selected calm fantasy person. No weapons, accessories, sci-fi alien styling, text, numbers, borders, logos or watermark.
